subject: WS B: tracks.json + usermodel.json layout D reads
body: For --taste-track P|S the loop reads data/researchers/tracks.json = {"P": "<slug>", "S": "<slug>"}. Please create it once the two researchers are chosen. In model mode the loop loads data/researchers/<slug>/usermodel.json with WS A's taste.usermodel.load_model(path, llm) (llm = the --judge backend). Prompt arms (R1-P-prompt/R1-S-prompt) paste choices.jsonl (a_text/b_text/context/chosen/reason are used if present) and corpus/*.txt verbatim, truncated to 8000 chars (research/advisor.history_text).
